description: Grounded-principal tier corpus (spec v0.7.0 §7.9, ADR-0041). Each case is one receipt, the answer a fixed resolver gives for its grant_ref, and the expected result. All three SDKs run every case and must agree: this is the verifier-agreement gate of ADR-0041 D8.

format.clock_skew_ms: The verifier's tolerance δ in milliseconds.
format.receipt: Keys risk_level, principal_id, action_timestamp and authorization: the values of credentialSubject.action.risk_level, credentialSubject.principal.id, credentialSubject.action.timestamp and credentialSubject.authorization (null means absent) on an otherwise minimal, unsigned receipt.
format.resolver: Either {grant}: the resolved grant, fields as in §7.9.1 with times as RFC 3339 strings and missing fields omitted, or {error}: a resolution failure.
format.receipt_times: Receipt times are read as RFC 3339 date-times (T/t, Z/z or a numeric offset with minutes, optional fraction, no leap second). An unreadable action.timestamp gives GRANT_VALIDITY_UNRESOLVED; an unreadable granted_at or expires_at raises no warning.
format.expected: {config_error: true} when the options are invalid; {checked: false} when the receipt is outside the tier; otherwise {checked: true, outcome, warnings}, where outcome null means grounded and warnings are codes in order: GRANTED_AT_DISAGREES, EXPIRES_AT_DISAGREES.
